name: vibe-plugins
description: The Vibe Plugins ecosystem — knowledge and structural foundations, plus pillars for vibe coding course correction, documentation, security, testing, and long-form academic authoring. Each plugin lives in its own solo repo; this marketplace aggregates the stable releases. For canary/edge releases, install each plugin's solo repo directly.

plugins.name: vibe-cartographer
plugins.description: Plot your course from idea to shipped app. Vibe coding course correction delivered as Claude Code slash commands: onboard, scope, prd, spec, checklist, build, iterate, reflect, evolve-cart, tend, vitals, friction, coder-voice.

plugins.name: vibe-doc
plugins.description: AI-powered documentation gap analyzer. Scans your codebase, classifies your project, identifies missing technical documentation, and generates professional docs from your existing artifacts.

plugins.name: vibe-test
plugins.description: Test analyzer and generator for vibe-coded apps. Classifies by app type and maturity tier, measures coverage honestly (no cherry-picked denominators), generates tests proportional to deployment risk — and catches the broken harnesses every other test tool assumes away.

plugins.name: vibe-sec
plugins.description: Security gap finder for vibe-coded apps — the tier-aware security audit and orchestration layer. Defers to gitleaks/OSV-Scanner/Semgrep/Trivy when present, falls back to an in-house baseline when absent, and owns the tier classification (mapped to OWASP ASVS), severity calibration, four-band report, confidence-routed fixes with destructive-action overrides, and threat-model synthesis. /vibe-sec:audit runs the full ten-concern audit (secrets, deps, supply-chain, config, crypto/PII, auth-model, OWASP survey, rate-limiting, threat-model, tier-scoring) — plus :scan, :deps, :gate (CI-safe), :posture, :fix, :threat-model, and :research. Validated on a real Firebase app.

plugins.name: thesis-engine
plugins.description: Research feeder for vibe-thesis projects. Discovers cutting-edge thesis topics, gathers primary sources / opposing positions / methodological precedents across five research axes, and emits research notes + a Pandoc-ready BibTeX bibliography in vibe-thesis-shaped subdirectories ready to drop into ThesisStudio. Optional Smart Brevity blog adapter for BlogStudio.

plugins.name: vibe-thesis
plugins.description: Beta — scaffold and co-author thesis-shaped artifacts (academic dissertations, master's theses, long-form research articles, position essays) with Claude Code. Works standalone with bundled templates; pairs with thesis-engine (optional research feeder) and the ThesisStudio template (optional richer styling) but neither is required. Say 'scaffold a vibe thesis project,' get a styled PDF skeleton plus a working render pipeline in roughly 30 minutes.

plugins.name: vibe-keystone
plugins.description: Bootstrap a 626Labs-pattern CLAUDE.md — the load-bearing structural file every agent decision in the repo rests on. Interviews the user for org, decision surface, voice rules, and persona before drafting, so the produced file reflects THEIR conventions, not 626Labs defaults baked in. Tenant-aware; adapts to repo type (code platform / marketing site / long-form writing / mixed). Use when starting a new repo or when an existing CLAUDE.md is stale.

plugins.name: vibe-iterate
plugins.description: Iterate on a shipped product, one PR at a time. First-run bootstrap identifies the app type and interviews you for competitors + framework pins. Recommends the right mode (feature-add, competitive, ux-polish, bug-bash) for the moment; ships with regression-aware, small-diff posture. Includes radar (digest what's new), rate (score an idea before committing), spy (single-URL competitor read), scan-releases (per-lib changes since last bump), upgrade (surgical lib bumps with codemods when available), ship (hand-written brief, no ingestion). Composes with vibe-cartographer when installed (heavy-iteration delegation). Self-evolves via session + friction logging — :evolve-iterate proposes improvements based on your usage patterns. No telemetry.

plugins.name: vibe-taker
plugins.description: Take it with you. Capture a feature out of one repo as a portable bundle (architecture sketch, contract surface, AI prompts, verbatim source snapshot, gotchas); plant it into another with stack-aware adaptation. /vibe-taker:capture reads source autonomously and only fires the interview gate when WHY can't be derived from source alone. /vibe-taker:plant detects the target's stack and picks code-lift on high match, spec-driven re-implementation on low match, or declines on hard cross-language mismatch — always with a mandatory diff confirmation before any write. /vibe-taker:list surfaces what's on the cross-repo shelf with search and Jaccard near-duplicate hints. Local-only by default; ~/.vibe-taker/library/ is the single source of truth.

plugins.name: vibe-walk
plugins.description: Generate user onboarding for your app — but only when it earns one. Reads your UI surfaces, names the aha moment, and gives an honest verdict on whether a tour helps or hurts before building anything (don't-build is a first-class output). When warranted, generates a short, instrumented, replayable Driver.js spotlight tour with a human-gated data-tour anchor pass, a 6-event analytics adapter, and trigger wiring that reuses your app's existing first-run state. Walkthrough mode for consumer apps; training mode comes later. Self-evolves via session + friction logging. No telemetry.

plugins.name: vibe-insights
plugins.description: Cross-machine, work-walled Claude Code session analytics — the verbose /insights over all your machines and history. Coverage, where-was-I recall, token/cost (incl. the cache reveal), trends, how-you-work (tool mix, delegation, per-machine), ranked open-threads with prune candidates, decisions, languages, per-session friction/satisfaction/outcome, and a synthesized narrative read. Walls employer sessions local-only. Standalone engine; optional cc-logs extra keeps token numbers aligned with sibling tools. MCP-agnostic decisions overlay. No telemetry.

plugins.name: vibe-wrap
plugins.description: Session wrap-up that reads the breadcrumb trail your toolkit already left — not a cold reconstruction. Multi-repo aware: surfaces what shipped across every repo the session touched, what's uncommitted, and what's unpushed, then gates commit + push on the current repo only (read wide, mutate narrow). Six-section handoff written to docs/session-wraps/ and inline; every gate defaults to no-action with a second confirmation on secret-pattern matches. Pluggable decision log (Markdown / JSONL / 626Labs MCP / off). Self-evolving via session + friction logs. No telemetry.

plugins.name: vibe-prompt
plugins.description: Audit, organize, classify, behaviorally test, grade, remediate, AND discover new prompts for your app's LLM features. /vibe-prompt:scan inventories every prompt site (registry-tracked + inline, with template-literal + string-concat + JSX-attr detection in addition to handlebars; classifies each user-input var as user-controlled / system-injected / unknown via naming heuristic + call-graph proximity); /vibe-prompt:audit fires structural findings across 13 smells (F1-F13 — F9 catches date-handling prompts without [CURRENT DATE] grounding; F10-F12 catch the prompt-injection vulnerability family on user-controlled vars only with F12 now API-parameter-aware (distinguishes systemInstruction parameter from contents[] user-turn, so contents-passed user vars are correctly recognized as structurally segregated regardless of layer order); F13 catches prompts with structural cues like [BRACKETS] + repeated {{vars}} + JSON-shaped data sections that don't declare their output format) with per-dimension scores on 5 dimensions (schema tightness, persona consistency, instruction clarity, token efficiency, injection resistance); /vibe-prompt:eval runs prompts against prod + in-session Claude baseline with SWRS calibration + Swap-and-Discard position-bias mitigation + verbosity penalty + cross-vendor evaluator-drift warnings + value-type-drift mechanical check + optional --inject-attacks mode that runs 6 canonical jailbreak fixtures (cost-gated, default $0.20 ceiling); /vibe-prompt:grade synthesizes audit + eval into composite grades on 5 dimensions with monotonic baseline regression tracking plus app-type weight heuristic; /vibe-prompt:remediate closes the audit-to-fix loop — generates per-finding diffs via four category-mapped templates (Category A composer-level additions for F9; Category B contradiction removal for F2 with banned-phrase + voice-frame sub-categories — voice-frame extension extracts voice rules from the global directive and detects voice-frame phrase contradictions in task prompts beyond direct banned-address matches; Category C defense addition for F10/F11 and F12-high fallback; new Category D migration templates close the audit-to-fix gap on F1/F4/F6 — D-1 inline-to-registry migration, D-2 typed-renderer addition with requiredVars, D-3 model-id consolidation) scored by a 5-dimension confidence rubric and routed by threshold (≥0.90 auto-write with backup; 0.70-0.89 stage for review; <0.70 inline-only); atomic rollback via .vibe-prompt/remediate/backup/<ISO>/; F10+F11(+F12-high) findings on the same call site consolidate into a single diff that closes all three; F12 critical fires explicit handoff banner to /vibe-sec:audit and the new --auto-handoff-vibe-sec flag invokes vibe-sec automatically (graceful fallback when vibe-sec unavailable); --apply-voice-frame-fixes opts in to auto-routing for voice-frame rewrites; v0.7 adds --apply-inline-to-registry / --apply-typed-renderer / --apply-model-consolidation for Category D; /vibe-prompt:iterate dispatches a creative-divergent LLM call to surface 3-5 new prompts your app could add (with handoff hints to /vibe-cartographer:scope or /vibe-iterate:feature-add); /vibe-prompt:first-run-setup auto-generates composer.json by detecting composer files (filename + SDK import) and classifying composition layers (global-directive / format-directive / knowledge-context / task-instruction / user-data) with apiParameter destination per layer (systemInstruction / contents / messages / instructions / prompt / null) — v0.7 detects four composer kinds (single-composer, multi-composer, multi-call-site, shared-package) and emits composers[] array per kind so multi-composer / multi-call-site apps are first-class. /vibe-prompt:scan v0.7 detects npm-workspaces and nested-projects monorepo shapes and emits per-workspace inventories plus a top-level aggregator; registry-kind classifier (prompt-content / model-routing / task-mapping / hybrid) gates F1 to fire only on prompt-content registries, eliminating false-positives on model-routing tables. /vibe-prompt:grade emits per-workspace composites for monorepo apps. F12 severity decoupled from composer-multiplicity (only detection-ambiguity degrades). /vibe-prompt:radar tracks model news; bare /vibe-prompt routes state-aware across 13 branches (workspace-rescan-needed, workspace-grade-needed, category-d-pending-review added in v0.7). F10-F12 findings emit cross-plugin handoff hints to /vibe-sec:audit for app-level user-input boundary review. TS/JS + Python coverage. Env-var-only key handling (VIBE_PROMPT_GEMINI_API_KEY). Validated on Celestia3 (Next.js + Firebase + Gemini) — caught the live cross-vendor Pilgrim leak that Gemini-2.5-flash produced despite the master directive prohibition.
